title: Veyrhold First Town Hub
summary: Veyrhold is the first release town: a civic oath hub with starter services, four district hooks, and early armor/accessory progression before the wider 12-city campaign opens.

services.label: Bellroot Anvil
services.summary: Temper low-tier weapons and teach the first armor upgrade language.

services.label: Oath-Lamp Still
services.summary: Brew safe health and focus consumables from reliquary dust and monster parts.

services.label: Oathmarket Stalls
services.summary: Trade city scrip for practical rings, amulets, and travel goods.

services.label: Pilgrim Rest
services.summary: Set a safe checkpoint, hear rumors, and recover before the road widens.

services.label: Warden Oath Board
services.summary: Post the first civic contracts for district threats, reputation, and local gear.

npcRoster.name: Dame Ivara Bellroot
npcRoster.summary: A shield-captain with a cracked bronze pauldron who still remembers every family name carved into the old steps.
npcRoster.dialogueHook: She asks whether the north gate opened because of courage, luck, or a promise the hero does not understand yet.
npcRoster.visualCue: Plain warden mail, oath-cloth sash, heavy tower shield leaning against the board.

npcRoster.name: Mara Cindersmith
npcRoster.summary: A practical smith who judges people by how they set a blade down before they speak.
npcRoster.dialogueHook: She can teach the first temper, but only if the hero brings proof the Brass Warden's oath did not break.
npcRoster.visualCue: Heat-dark apron, brass hand wraps, ember-lit forge tongs, no decorative high technology.

npcRoster.name: Ilo
npcRoster.summary: A small blue-lit oracle who speaks softly when the oath-lamps flicker and loudly when nobody listens.
npcRoster.dialogueHook: Ilo thinks the blue lamps are not warnings; they are invitations from something under Veyrhold.
npcRoster.visualCue: Warm moth-blue glow, little brass mantle, floating lamp beads, curious expression.

npcRoster.name: Tovin of the Oathmarket
npcRoster.summary: A smiling broker who knows which rings are sentimental, which are cursed, and which are merely overpriced.
npcRoster.dialogueHook: Tovin will open the plain accessory table after the hero resolves a debt written in witness-brass.
npcRoster.visualCue: Layered market scarf, ring trays, belt of stamped promise coins.

npcRoster.name: Sister Vael of the Rows
npcRoster.summary: A road-weary healer who treats vows like wounds: clean them, bind them, check them again before sunrise.
npcRoster.dialogueHook: She offers the first safe road blessing if the hero listens to three pilgrims and does not mock any of them.
npcRoster.visualCue: Travel cloak, tin prayer rings, stitched boot kit, soft lamp tied to a walking staff.

miniQuests.title: The Ledger That Would Not Close
miniQuests.summary: Settle a witness-brass debt so the Oathmarket trusts the hero with starter accessories.
steps: Ask the bell-ringer who signed last
miniQuests.unlockCopy: Opens the plain ring table and teaches that Veyrhold law is warmer than it looks.

miniQuests.title: Shield Fitting at the Steps
miniQuests.summary: Let Ivara and Mara refit the starter kit so armor progression begins with craftable, visible upgrades.
steps: Hold stance through three hammer rings
Choose helm, gloves, or chest first
miniQuests.unlockCopy: Opens the first armor upgrade language for helm, armor, gloves, and boots.

miniQuests.title: Blue Lamps in Bellroot Commons
miniQuests.summary: Follow Ilo through three blue oath-lamps and learn why the city is answering the reliquary.
steps: Listen to the house with no door
Bottle the blue ash before it fades
miniQuests.unlockCopy: Opens safe alchemy work and the first city mystery chain.

miniQuests.title: Three Pilgrims and a Road Blessing
miniQuests.summary: Hear the first road rumors before leaving town, then bind a blessing into the hero's travel kit.
steps: Hear the child who saw the north gate blink
miniQuests.unlockCopy: Makes the inn checkpoint feel like story preparation, not just a reset button.

serviceOutcomes.label: First Temper
serviceOutcomes.result: Mara tempers the active weapon and explains why bland common gear should slowly gain silhouette, not random glow.

serviceOutcomes.label: Safe Vials
serviceOutcomes.result: Ilo steadies the still while the hero bottles health and focus supplies for the next road.

serviceOutcomes.label: Starter Wares
serviceOutcomes.result: Tovin unlocks practical rings and the first accessory comparison lesson.

serviceOutcomes.label: Road Checkpoint
serviceOutcomes.result: Sister Vael binds the next checkpoint to a warm lamp and a plain tin ring.

serviceOutcomes.label: First Civic Contract
serviceOutcomes.result: Dame Ivara posts the first town contract and marks the hero as witnessed by Veyrhold.

districtMapNodes.label: Oathmarket
districtMapNodes.summary: A warm, crowded promise-market where plain rings, city scrip, rumors, and first vendor choices teach the economy.
districtMapNodes.visualMood: canvas awnings, brass oath coins, ring trays, small lamps reflected in wet stone
districtMapNodes.releaseAction: Visit the market and unlock the first accessory comparison path.

districtMapNodes.label: Warden's Steps
districtMapNodes.summary: Stepped civic stone, old shield marks, and forge heat make this the first place the hero learns armor identity.
districtMapNodes.visualMood: bronze stair rails, oath banners, shield racks, hammer sparks under a civic arch
districtMapNodes.releaseAction: Visit the steps and start the first armor upgrade path.

districtMapNodes.label: Bellroot Commons
districtMapNodes.mapRole: alchemy, Ilo follow-up, and city mystery lane
districtMapNodes.summary: A softer residential commons where oath-lamps glow blue and the reliquary answers through small household rituals.
districtMapNodes.visualMood: blue oath-lamps, moss between warm stones, little oracle lights, quiet doorways
districtMapNodes.releaseAction: Visit the commons and open the first alchemy and city-mystery follow-up.

districtMapNodes.label: Pilgrim Rows
districtMapNodes.mapRole: inn, checkpoint, rumors, and road prep lane
districtMapNodes.summary: Narrow sleeping rows and lantern rails prepare the hero for the next road without making travel feel like a menu.
districtMapNodes.visualMood: travel cloaks, tin rings, bedside lamps, road maps pinned under string
districtMapNodes.releaseAction: Visit the rows and bind the first checkpoint and road blessing.

oathmarketVendorWares.label: Copper Oath Ring
oathmarketVendorWares.comparisonCopy: A plain defensive ring: small ward and focus gains, intentionally bland so later rare/relic rings look meaningfully different.

oathmarketVendorWares.label: Pilgrim Tin Ring
oathmarketVendorWares.comparisonCopy: A travel ring: tiny speed and resonance gains for road prep, not a combat spike.

oathmarketVendorWares.label: Bellroot Cord Amulet
oathmarketVendorWares.comparisonCopy: A starter necklace path: ward and resonance now, with lamp-glass silhouettes reserved for rare and relic upgrades.

oathmarketVendorWares.label: Road Health Vial
oathmarketVendorWares.comparisonCopy: A practical road supply that keeps the first town economy useful without replacing combat rewards.

oathmarketLedgerChoices.label: Mercy ruling
oathmarketLedgerChoices.summary: Tovin loses a little coin but the market warms to the hero as someone who protects frightened pilgrims.
oathmarketLedgerChoices.outcomeCopy: Better reputation and road-travel flavor; weaker immediate crafting pressure.

oathmarketLedgerChoices.label: Strict ruling
oathmarketLedgerChoices.summary: The ledgers balance cleanly and the market guild trusts the hero with sharper prices.
oathmarketLedgerChoices.outcomeCopy: Better early upgrade material pressure; colder local response.

oathmarketLedgerChoices.label: Witness compromise
oathmarketLedgerChoices.summary: The bell-ringer witnesses a compromise that keeps both families in the market.
oathmarketLedgerChoices.outcomeCopy: Balanced accessory reward and reputation, ideal for the first-release default path.

wardensStepsArmorFittings.label: Oath-Bronze Visor Fit
wardensStepsArmorFittings.visualUpgrade: A dented pilgrim cap gains a low bronze brow, small cheek guards, and the first visible oath etch.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.statLesson: Helm fittings teach ward and focus defense before flashy relic silhouettes appear.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.comparisonCopy: Plain protection now; uncommon and rare helms become noticeably more civic, crested, and oath-marked.

wardensStepsArmorFittings.label: Civic Wardplate Repair
wardensStepsArmorFittings.visualUpgrade: Patched bronze plates get a warmer center seal, cleaner shoulder lines, and fewer mismatched straps.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.statLesson: Chest armor is the main ward budget: slower, sturdier, and visibly heavier as quality rises.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.comparisonCopy: A practical tank path for early survival; epic wardplate should look unmistakably city-forged.

wardensStepsArmorFittings.label: Forge-Grip Glove Stitch
wardensStepsArmorFittings.visualUpgrade: Work leather gains brass knuckle plates, tool-stitch seams, and a small forge stamp.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.statLesson: Gloves lean into might, speed, and crafting identity rather than raw armor.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.comparisonCopy: A hand-feel upgrade: bland common leather first, then visible grip plates for better strikes and forging.

wardensStepsArmorFittings.label: Roadwarden Sole Fit
wardensStepsArmorFittings.visualUpgrade: Soft road boots gain reinforced heel bands, route-rune straps, and a brighter sole edge.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.statLesson: Boot fittings make speed, dodge timing, and road readiness readable without becoming high-tech.
wardensStepsArmorFittings.comparisonCopy: A mobility path for the first road: better soles, clearer dodge identity, and later rare route marks.

wardensStepsOathContracts.label: Hold the Shield Line
wardensStepsOathContracts.stance: stand with the old wardens during a civic drill
wardensStepsOathContracts.summary: The hero learns why Veyrhold armor begins as plain duty before it becomes legendary metal.
wardensStepsOathContracts.outcomeCopy: Best early reputation path: a shield-drill contract that makes low-tier armor feel earned.

wardensStepsOathContracts.label: Witness the First Temper
wardensStepsOathContracts.stance: help Mara certify a safe repair for pilgrim armor
wardensStepsOathContracts.summary: Mara turns a routine fitting into a lesson about quality tiers, materials, and honest silhouettes.
wardensStepsOathContracts.outcomeCopy: Best crafting path: more upgrade pressure and the first hint that relic-tier armor needs proof, not sparkle.

wardensStepsOathContracts.label: Take the Step Watch
wardensStepsOathContracts.stance: watch the civic steps while apprentices carry armor through the crowd
wardensStepsOathContracts.summary: A quiet town-watch job introduces armor as social identity: who trusts the hero, who steps aside, and who does not.
wardensStepsOathContracts.outcomeCopy: Best town-readiness path: safer supplies and stronger civic warmth before the next road opens.

bellrootCommonsBrews.label: Safe Health Vials
bellrootCommonsBrews.summary: Ilo steadies the blue flame while the hero learns why safe healing starts with patient heat, not stronger magic.
bellrootCommonsBrews.outcomeCopy: Basic recovery for the first road; later alchemy can specialize into cleanses and resistance draughts.

bellrootCommonsBrews.label: Quiet Focus Draught
bellrootCommonsBrews.summary: The draught hums only after the hero lets the lamp settle, teaching calm resource recovery before harder roads.
bellrootCommonsBrews.outcomeCopy: A starter mana/focus support lane for Relicweaver-style play without turning alchemy into a full economy yet.

bellrootCommonsBrews.label: Blue Ash Cleanse
bellrootCommonsBrews.summary: A pale blue ash gathers under the lamp bowl, giving the first safe lesson about future poison, curse, and burn counters.
bellrootCommonsBrews.outcomeCopy: A teaching brew: small reward now, clear future hook for status cleanses and dungeon preparation.

bellrootLampReadings.label: House With No Door
bellrootLampReadings.mysteryHook: A blue lamp shines from a sealed house and answers Ilo before any person speaks.
bellrootLampReadings.summary: The hero learns the city is not haunted in the normal way; some homes are listening for oaths older than Veyrhold.
bellrootLampReadings.outcomeCopy: Adds the first civic mystery clue and points toward later city-catacomb storytelling.

bellrootLampReadings.label: Moth-Lamp Circle
bellrootLampReadings.mysteryHook: Three lamps attract brass-winged moths that circle only when the hero stands still.
bellrootLampReadings.summary: Ilo insists the moths are counting the hero's pauses, not their steps, introducing quiet observation as a real verb.
bellrootLampReadings.outcomeCopy: Builds the non-combat mystery loop: stop, listen, record, then prepare before the next road.

bellrootLampReadings.label: Root Under the Bell
bellrootLampReadings.mysteryHook: A bellroot thread under the cobbles rings like metal when the oath-lamp warms.
bellrootLampReadings.summary: The reading ties Veyrhold's warm civic face to something older under the district, useful for later dungeon keys.
bellrootLampReadings.outcomeCopy: The strongest early mystery clue: it rewards patience and hints that alchemy, city roots, and relic doors are connected.

pilgrimRowsRestOptions.label: Lamp Checkpoint
pilgrimRowsRestOptions.summary: Sister Vael ties a warm lamp to the hero's travel kit so the next road has a believable recovery anchor.
pilgrimRowsRestOptions.outcomeCopy: Sets the first town checkpoint as a story action instead of a bare reset button.

pilgrimRowsRestOptions.label: Boot Mending
pilgrimRowsRestOptions.summary: The hero learns why plain boots, dry socks, and a careful sole check matter before Warden roads become dangerous.
pilgrimRowsRestOptions.outcomeCopy: Reinforces low-tier gear identity and points back to the roadwarden boot path.

pilgrimRowsRestOptions.label: Dawn Meal
pilgrimRowsRestOptions.summary: A quiet meal gives the first town a humane pause between civic errands and the next route card.
pilgrimRowsRestOptions.outcomeCopy: Adds a soft recovery beat for caster and melee starts without creating a full food system yet.

pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.label: Lantern Caravan
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.rumorHook: A caravan with no horses passed the north stones before dawn, every lantern covered in blue cloth.
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.routeHint: Watch for road events that ask for observation before combat.
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.outcomeCopy: Turns rumors into route-readiness proof and warns that not every road event should start with fighting.

pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.label: Salt-Road Widow
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.rumorHook: A widow says the salt road remembers boots, not names, and that the wrong footprint can wake old tolls.
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.routeHint: Future road checks can use boots, rings, and reputation as soft gates.
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.outcomeCopy: Connects the Pilgrim Tin Ring to travel identity and makes accessory choices feel useful outside combat.

pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.label: North Gate Blink
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.rumorHook: A child saw the north gate blink after it opened, like something beyond it was waking one eye at a time.
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.routeHint: The next route should carry mystery pressure from Veyrhold instead of feeling like a generic travel menu.
pilgrimRowsRoadRumors.outcomeCopy: The strongest road clue: it ties Veyrhold's checkpoint, Bellroot mystery, and future gate routes together.

districtHooks.label: Oathmarket
districtHooks.firstConflict: Merchants refuse to sell oath-metal until the hero proves the north gate opened cleanly.

districtHooks.label: Warden's Steps
districtHooks.releaseRole: blacksmith, oath board, and shield training
districtHooks.firstConflict: The old wardens want the Brass Warden's defeat witnessed before they re-open civic training.

districtHooks.label: Bellroot Commons
districtHooks.releaseRole: alchemy, recovery, and Ilo story follow-up
districtHooks.firstConflict: The oath-lamps burn blue around certain homes, hinting at the first city-side mystery.

districtHooks.label: Pilgrim Rows
districtHooks.releaseRole: inn checkpoint, rumors, and road preparation
districtHooks.firstConflict: Pilgrims whisper that the next gate wants a city oath, not another key.

starterGearProgression.visualRule: Common helms stay dented and practical; rare helms gain cleaner crests and visible oath-etching.
Low-tier plate is patched bronze; epic plate gains a clear city seal and warmer ward glow.
Common gloves read like work leather; rare gloves show brass knuckle plates and crafting marks.
Common boots are soft travel gear; rare boots gain route-rune straps and a brighter sole edge.
Common rings are plain copper; relic rings show a floating civic seal and distinct silhouette.
Low-tier rings are nearly bland; unique/relic variants use asymmetric stones and route-mark glow.
Common amulets are cord and brass; higher tiers gain lamp-glass cores and recognizable aura color.

releaseAcceptance: Veyrhold exposes at least five services after the town opens.
Armor progression explicitly covers helm, armor, gloves, and boots.
Accessory progression explicitly covers rings and amulet/necklace identity.
Services use existing local-first game actions or drawer routes.
Future cities remain locked previews until later city slices.
